Independent Oxford Learner and Etymonline trace the exact music word to disc, corroborating this root spelling independently even though disc also happens to be a free English noun. Grouped entries do not give every variant a proof for every example. Collins incorporates Random House’s dictionary wording: borrowed from French discographie, see disc, -o-, -graphy. Oxford/Etymonline cite disc + -graphy but omit an explicit o segmentation: literally disc + graphy would omit a letter. Treat -o- as a connecting vowel or explicit grouping in an instructional analysis; do not pretend these shorthand etymologies establish a different unique original English segmentation.
